title: Trust Canal canonical mission-ID allocation request
goal: Allow a verified Mission candidate to request canonical V2 mission-ID allocation through Trust Canal without allocating an ID or starting execution.
laws: Only a durable CANDIDATE-* identity may request allocation.
The candidate must exist under missions/candidates and remain non-executing.
Allocation request is a separate Trust Canal intent and receipt.
Admission of the request does not allocate a V2 mission ID.
No missions/V2-*.json file is created by this mission from the candidate.
No active mission, Talos, Hephaestus, Worker or shell execution starts.
Request replay is deterministic and idempotent.
